data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 厨房里的试味
data.description: 锅里的汤刚煮好，雪菜舀起一小勺尝了尝，看看味道是否合适。
data.action: tasting soup with a spoon beside a pot
data.promptProse: In a brightly lit, cozy home kitchen, Setsuna holds a small porcelain spoon near her lips, gently blowing on steaming vegetable soup with a proud smile. Stainless steel saucepans simmer on the stove, with freshly chopped carrots on the cutting board and soft morning sunlight filling the room.
